sql: CREATE TABLE audit_pred(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,k INT,v TEXT)
UPDATE audit_pred SET k=99 WHERE id='a' AND k=2
DELETE FROM audit_pred WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM audit_pred WHERE k=2) AND k=3
UPDATE audit_pred SET k=k+10 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM audit_pred WHERE k<3)
SELECT id,k,v FROM audit_pred ORDER BY id
